description: Move a resource, such as a database, to another plan in place. Its data and environment variables stay the same, and attached apps do not restart. A plan change can change what the resource costs, so first call with preview set to true, show the person what changes, and change the plan only once they confirm. The preview lists each limit's current use and its value on both plans, and says what an attached app notices while the change applies. A move to a plan the resource would not fit is refused and changes nothing. list_catalog_resources names the plans. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the resource belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

plan.description: The plan to move to, as list_catalog_resources names it.

preview.description: Report what the change would do without making it. Preview first and confirm with the person before changing the plan.

resource.description: The resource's name in the organization.

name: set_resource_plan

from_plan.description: The plan the resource was on.

interruption.description: Set on a preview: what an attached app notices while the change applies. Absent when it notices nothing.

limits.description: Set on a preview: each limit's current use and its value on both plans.

display.description: The limit's name for a person to read.

name.description: The limit's name, such as storage or connections.

used.description: How much of the limit the resource uses now. Absent when the provider cannot say.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the resource belongs to.

reason.description: Set when pending: why the last attempt did not finish.

status.description: previewed when nothing changed, applied when the resource is on to_plan, or pending when Valet accepted the change and is still applying it.

title: Change a resource's plan
